title: Fonte unica de templates, parte 4 de 4: derivar o inventario de arquivos instalados do mapa embarcado
description:
Replace the four parallel hand-enumerations of the installed file set (two of them already stale: setup.ts claims 6 commands where 7 ship and 3 scripts/cam files where 7 ship) with a derivation from the embedded template map. Independent of the other three slices: it touches src/commands/setup.ts and index.ts only, and no template or installed copy.

---

PROCEDENCIA

Fatia derivada do CAM-534, que por sua vez carrega o spec corrigido do CAM-530. A divisao foi decidida depois de duas escalacoes do plan (quatro rodadas de planner e auditor) em que o auditor sinalizou atomicidade nas duas vezes e o PRD unico chegou a 15 criterios numa unica story sobre cerca de 12 arquivos. As quatro fatias sao mudancas quase independentes; a medicao completa, a classificacao dos 39 hunks e a decisao de mecanismo vivem no CAM-530 e no CAM-534 e nao sao repetidas aqui.

spec.scope: Replace the four parallel hand-enumerations of the installed file set (two of them already stale: setup.ts claims 6 commands where 7 ship and 3 scripts/cam files where 7 ship) with a derivation from the embedded template map. Independent of the other three slices: it touches src/commands/setup.ts and index.ts only, and no template or installed copy.
gotchas: BINDING INSTRUCTION TO THE PLANNER, and the reason this issue exists as its own slice: every oracle text in these acceptance criteria is ALREADY SWEPT and must be carried into the PRD VERBATIM, character for character, including the exit-code protocol, the diagnostic-marker greps, the empty-anchor guards and the gate names. Do NOT re-author, paraphrase, weaken, rename a gate, or substitute a shorter equivalent. MEASURED HISTORY: this work escalated twice, four planner-plus-auditor rounds, and on both escalations the auditor re-raised findings that the spec had ALREADY FIXED, because the PRD carried re-authored weaker criteria instead of the spec text (the gate-wiring criterion lost its `GATES.some(g => g.name === ...)` identity assertion and the gates were silently renamed; the Claude Code discovery criterion was dropped entirely despite the spec carrying both the criterion and the full five-surface measurement). If a criterion seems wrong, surface it as a finding; do not silently soften it.

HIGHEST SEVERITY, green gate with lost coverage: `Bun.Glob.scanSync` silently omits symlinks under default options. Measured on bun 1.3.13 against a directory holding 457 symlinks and 1 regular file: default scanSync returned 1 of 458 entries, zero of the 457 symlinks; with `followSymlinks: true` OR `onlyFiles: false` it returned 458/458. `scripts/validate-agents-md.ts:64-65` runs `new Glob('.claude/agents/*.md').scanSync({ cwd, dot: true })` with defaults. After US-002, `subagent-orchestrator.md` and `subagent-planner.md` become symlinks and DROP OUT of the agents-md scan surface (7 targets to 5) WITHOUT the gate turning red. Fix `followSymlinks: true` and keep the derived-target-count pin as a hard acceptance criterion. `scripts/check-file-sizes.ts`, `check-test-sleeps.ts`, `check-test-tmpdir.ts` and `check-debt-markers.ts` also use scanSync but only over `{src,scripts,test}/**`, where no symlinks are planned; that assumption is pinned by the templates-contain-no-symlinks criterion.

ORDERING, and it can break the implementer's own live session: the symlink target is not executable today. `git ls-files -s` reports `.claude/hooks/orch-agent-allowlist.sh` = 100755 and `templates/.claude/hooks/orch-agent-allowlist.sh` = 100644. `.claude/settings.json` registers the hook as a bare command path, so the exec bit is load-bearing; invoking the template copy returns rc=126. Run `git update-index --chmod=+x templates/.claude/hooks/orch-agent-allowlist.sh` BEFORE creating the link, otherwise the implementer loses its own PreToolUse allowlist mid-story. `test/embedded.test.ts` only asserts the MATERIALIZED mode (materializeTemplates chmods 0o755 at write time), so it is blind to this; no existing gate covers the repo's own hook mode.

CROSS-STORY DEPENDENCY, not inferable from the story text: US-003 depends on US-001. US-001 adds roughly 41 lines to `templates/scripts/cam/CLAUDE.md` and rewrites step 3 of `templates/agents/subagent-implementer.md`. Any overlay anchored on pre-US-001 template text goes to zero-match (exit 2) the moment US-001 lands. Author every overlay against the POST-US-001 base.

OVERLAY SEMANTICS, pin it explicitly: every `find` must match exactly once against the PRISTINE base, and all matches must be resolved before any replacement is written. Two pairs rewrite lines containing `unnecessary re-renders` (reviewer line 80 and rubric row 8 at line 120) and two rewrite lines containing `<project typecheck command>` (CLAUDE.md lines 29 and 53). If pairs are applied sequentially against the already-mutated buffer, anchor counts change mid-run and the arity check becomes meaningless.

SIX ANCHORS collide in their short form and need the long form: (a) bare `<project typecheck command>` matches 2 lines, use the 3-line gates block; (b) `NO \`_ref\` channel` matches 2 sub-bullets, include `jscpd also has`; (c) `No hardcoded secrets` matches 2 lines, include the trailing `in code.`; (d) `unnecessary re-renders` matches 2 lines, anchor on the full `| 8 | **perf** |` table row; (e) bare `typecheck` matches 3 lines and bare `\`bun test\`` matches 2, use the prefix through `discovered at review time,`; (f) merge the reviewer's four checklist sections into ONE pair anchored on `### Security` rather than four pairs.

TWO HUNKS REQUIRE TEXT THAT EXISTS ON NEITHER SIDE and must be authored: the implementer's `97c97,107` quality-gate block and the auditor's `91a95,102` section F. A story phrased as "update the template to match the repo" will silently produce a stack-specific base. The generic base text for both is specified in the story body; do not let the implementer improvise it.

NUMBERING HAZARD: propagating the auditor carve-outs (items 21 and 25) into a NUMBERED list renumbers both sides. Merge auditor hunks 3+4+5 into a single overlay pair anchored on `Project-specific sanity`; two separate pairs would strand a base item 21/22 in the middle of the repo's item list.

ZERO HEADROOM on every file this PRD touches. Measured actual/budget: scripts/check-all.ts 491/491, test/check-all.test.ts 478/478, src/commands/setup.ts 1268/1268, src/vendor/_generated.ts 51/51, src/templates/embedded.ts 124/124, scripts/generate-embedded-vendor.ts 159/159. Each needs a scripts/file-size-budget.json raise plus a dated `_ref` note naming CAM-530, and `git add scripts/file-size-budget.json` BEFORE re-running the gate, because the tracker-ref check reads only the staged diff. index.ts (3366 lines) is NOT budgeted (outside the {src,scripts,test} glob), so INIT_HELP changes are free.

CORRECTION to a common assumption: new `scripts/*.ts` files do NOT need budget entries. `checkSizeCeilings` iterates `Object.entries(budget)` and skips undefined actuals; it never iterates the glob. Proof: scripts/validate-agents-md.ts is 516 lines with no budget entry and the gate is green. Adding entries for the new generator is hygiene, not a gate requirement, so do not write an acceptance criterion asserting the new script has a budget entry.

`test/templates/orchestrator-boot.test.ts` degenerates after US-002 and must be collapsed deliberately, not left alone. Its `describe.each` runs over the repo copy read from disk AND the template copy from `templatesContents`; once the pair is one inode, the two legs differ only by embed staleness, which `embed-vendor` already covers byte-for-byte. Collapse it to a single-source assertion over `templatesContents['agents/subagent-orchestrator.md']` and record that the redundancy now comes from `embed-vendor` plus the symlink-integrity gate. The sibling `test/templates/subagent-reviewer-clean-findings.test.ts` is the OPPOSITE case: subagent-reviewer.md is overlay-generated, so its two legs stay genuinely independent and the test gains value. But no string it asserts may appear in any overlay `find`/`replace`, or an overlay edit could satisfy one leg while breaking the other.

`.claude/commands/direct-fix.md` is tracked in the repo and absent from `templates/`. It is excluded from the symlink population by construction (the oracle iterates the template tree forward) and it must NOT be added to `templates/`: that would make `_generated.ts` 52 lines and trip the 51-line budget.

`test/embedded.test.ts:105` (exact key-set equality between templatesContents and an on-disk walk) is unaffected, but only because of link direction. Both walkers use statSync, which FOLLOWS symlinks; the walk root is `templates/`, and `.claude/` is not reachable from it. Verified: `bun scripts/generate-embedded-vendor.ts --check` exits 0 with templateFiles=27 and _generated.ts at 51 lines. Note the walkers differ: `walkFiles()` guards with isFile() while the test's own `walk()` does not, so a dangling link inside templates/ throws ENOENT in both but with different messages.

SYMLINK CREATION IS NOT EXPRESSIBLE VIA THE Write TOOL. US-002 needs Bash (`ln -s`) plus `git update-index --chmod=+x`. Verified the allowlist hook does not block this PRD: `.claude/hooks/orch-agent-allowlist.sh:86` denies CAM_WORKER=1 writes only for `*scripts/cam/prd.json` and `*scripts/cam/issues/*`; every write target here is allowed.

This repo has ZERO tracked symlinks today (`git ls-files -s | awk '$1=="120000"'` is empty), so US-002 introduces the first ones. `git config core.symlinks` is unset (defaults true on macOS/Linux) and `readlink -f` is available, with `/bin/realpath` as fallback. CI runner symlink support is UNVERIFIED and must be a US-002 smoke, not an assumption.

SHELL AUTHORING HAZARDS hit while sweeping, both cost a false result: (a) backticks inside a sed anchor get command-substituted if the oracle is wrapped in `bash -c "..."`; every anchor in this spec contains backticks, so oracles must be delivered as plain multi-line snippets or single-quoted throughout. (b) `grep -F '- **Test quality**:'` fails with "invalid option" because the pattern starts with `-`; it must be `grep -F -e '...'`.

SCOPE DECLARATION, state it in the PRD so a future reader does not "fix" it: "stack-agnostic base" is an ASPIRATION, not a currently-true invariant. 22 lines of SHARED, non-divergent template text already name bun, tmux or cam-cli source paths (subagent-reviewer.md 13, subagent-implementer.md 7, subagent-auditor.md 1, templates/scripts/cam/CLAUDE.md 1). Consequence: the overlay boundary in this PRD is "what differs", NOT "stack-specific versus agnostic". Making the aspiration true is CAM-533 and is deliberately out of scope here, because those lines live in the shared portion that none of these four stories touches.

HUNK OWNERSHIP IS SPEC-DECIDED, NOT IMPLEMENTER-DECIDED. All 39 divergent hunks are classified in the story bodies: 1 TEMPLATE-WINS, 10 REPO-WINS, 28 OVERLAY-OWNED, with 11 carve-outs (8 overlay carve-outs inside repo-wins hunks, 3 repo-wins carve-outs inside overlay-owned hunks). The implementer must not adjudicate any hunk. Post-reconciliation the 28 overlay hunks plus 7 applied carve-outs collapse into 22 {find, replace} pairs (5 CLAUDE.md, 3 implementer, 3 auditor, 11 reviewer). None of the four overlay files graduates to symlink; do not promise that.

DIFF ALIGNMENT ARTIFACTS: after US-001 lands, re-diffing will re-align two hunk pairs differently (CLAUDE.md `33c46`/`34a48,49`, the Biome paragraph versus the --no-verify line; and `59c75`/`60a77,115`, where the Marking-a-bullet-resolved paragraph is relocated into the new section and retitled). Do not read the new alignment as fresh divergence.

MEASURED, and it retires the biggest open risk in this PRD: Claude Code discovers symlinked `.claude/` entries on all five surfaces (commands, agents, skills, settings.json, hooks), and does so deliberately rather than accidentally. Commands and agents: ripgrep with unconditional `--follow` at claude-code-harness/utils/markdownConfigLoader.ts:564-568, proved empirically against a real symlinked .md (with `--follow` listed and exit 0, without it exit 1) and against a symlinked DIRECTORY with the same result. Skills: `!entry.isDirectory() && !entry.isSymbolicLink()` reject-filter at skills/loadSkillsDir.ts:425. settings.json: `realpathSync` at utils/settings/settings.ts:206, with a dedicated broken-symlink log line proving links are an expected input. Hooks: a shell command string spawned through `/bin/sh -c`, no stat gate, and `execve` follows links. `Bun.Glob` has ZERO occurrences in that discovery path. Corroboration that this is designed behavior: Claude Code ships `worktree.symlinkDirectories` (utils/settings/types.ts:440-447), a feature that deliberately plants symlinked directories inside project trees. CAVEAT ON PROVENANCE: claude-code-harness/ is a gitignored, untracked local reference copy, so it may drift from the installed binary; the empirical ripgrep probes were run against the real bundled binary and are the stronger evidence.

The `scripts/validate-agents-md.ts` symlink fix is now measured with the exact call shape, not inferred: `new Glob('.claude/agents/*.md').scanSync({ cwd, dot: true })` returned 0 entries over a symlink-only directory, while `scanSync({ cwd, dot: true, followSymlinks: true })` returned 11. Because that scanner excludes `templates/**` by construction, the un-fixed version reports SUCCESS while validating nothing. Contrast, and do not "fix" it: `vendor/check-agent-frontmatter.ts:210` uses `readdirSync(AGENT_DIR)` WITHOUT `withFileTypes`, which returns plain strings and is symlink-safe as-is. The silent-drop idiom to watch for anywhere else is `readdirSync(dir,{withFileTypes:true}).filter(e => e.isFile())`, measured at 0 of 11 on the same directory; the safe form adds `|| e.isSymbolicLink()`.

PORTABILITY CONDITION on the symlink collapse: a contributor whose git has `core.symlinks=false` (the Windows default) gets the links materialized as plain text files containing their target paths, which breaks all five discovery surfaces at once. The US-002 index-mode criterion (asserting mode 120000 in the index rather than `test -L` on disk) is what catches this, and it is the reason that criterion checks the index. LATENT, not currently in play: claude-code-harness/utils/plugins/validatePlugin.ts:737 filters skills directories with a bare `.filter(e => e.isDirectory())` and WOULD drop a symlinked skill dir, while the runtime loader accepts it. That validator/runtime divergence only bites if `templates/` is ever shipped as a Claude Code plugin; the repo has no `.claude-plugin/` marker today.

AUDIT FINDING F-05, applies to the story that authors the two new base blocks: a criterion asserting text lands "byte-for-byte as authored" is not verified by an oracle that only checks two anchors are non-empty, that no bun/Ink/tmux token appears, and that two phrases are present, because improvised prose containing those phrases passes. This is the one place in the PRD where NEW instruction text is authored that ships to every downstream project, so it needs a fidelity-grade comparand: diff a here-doc of the authored text against the sed-extracted block, the same shape as the CLAUDE.md line-set criterion.

AUDIT FINDING F-06, a self-contradicting criterion to avoid when collapsing `test/templates/orchestrator-boot.test.ts`: asking the implementer to record the collapse rationale in the test header while the oracle forbids the literal string `.claude` anywhere in that file makes the natural rationale sentence redden the gate. Either state that the header must avoid the bare token, or narrow the absence check to a path-literal form such as `! grep -qF "'.claude'"`.

abandonedReason: Premissa morta: o issue depende de src/commands/setup.ts e de um mapa de templates embarcado que nao existem mais no produto web-first. Derivar o inventario de arquivos instalados recriaria o runtime de instalacao ja aposentado.
